question: What topics are included in the investigation of the paths beginning with kalā?
premises: The verse names the sequence of phoneme divisions.
It names the explanation of the all-supporting power.
These are said to be analyzed within the investigation of the paths beginning with kalā.
inference: The kalā-centered path analysis includes both phonemic order and foundational śakti doctrine.
uncertainties: The final long token is syntactically dense and may mark a sectional boundary.
plain_english: The sequence of the divisions of the phonemes and the explanation of the all-supporting power are analyzed to this extent within the investigation of the paths beginning with kalā.
